purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S2-11. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md. NOT RUNNABLE (HOLD): see not_runnable_reason.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: HOLD: Superseded by register amendment A41 (2026-10-13): the S2-11 rerun runs from campaign_C10_DIAGb only. S2-11 ran from this plan once, as run_0075 (timed out, invalid for scoring under the frozen scorer, sealed, never substituted). Invoking this plan would reuse run_0075 (or later the rerun) by its label, and because this plan is not state-only its summary would copy that run's metrics into results/campaigns/campaign_C10_DIAGa_S2-11.json.

Frozen register (register-rev2-frozen-20261010T1833Z) section 3: 24 of the 26 diagnostic launches, in the register order (S2-11 first), in three plans: campaign_C10_DIAGa_S2-11 (S2-11), campaign_C10_DIAG (S2, S3 confinement, AFF: 19 entries, reusing S2-11) and campaign_C10_DIAG_HF (H-F: 5 entries, held until the H-F scoring is frozen). S6-13 / S6-15 follow S4c (template entries). An entry already launched under the same label (any C10 plan) is reused, never re-launched.

S2-11 first: launch campaign_C10_DIAGa_S2-11 alone (run_campaign continues after a failure), score it (score_register.py hc_mesh <S2-11 run> <run_0067>), then launch campaign_C10_DIAG, which reuses the S2-11 launch by its label.

S2-11 halves the oxide y.mesh spacing at the 0.002 / 0.017 um lines and keeps the y = 0 line: Al2O3 refined about x1.5, HfO2 about x2. Its verdict covers QTNLSC only; S2-12/S2-13 (ITAT) use TAT.SLICEPTS = 12 (default, untested) and cannot count as converged under H-C without a logged amendment (e.g. a TAT.SLICEPTS sensitivity launch).

Scoring is frozen in analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/score_register.py (H-B hb_ratio/hb_transfer, H-C hc_nominal/hc_generation/hc_mesh/hc_worst/hc_explains, H-E aff/he_alloff/s3_minus_s105); below-resolution quantities are censored (register section 0), never a pass. H-F: no frozen scorer yet (campaign_C10_DIAG_HF is held).
S2 stop rules of campaign_C10_S2_offfloor apply; IGZO runs need post_run_checks.py activation; no S3 branch is adopted from this plan.

runs.purpose: Numerics of the leakage result (register H-C, S2-11 redefined; first S2 launch): S0-02 (run_0067 form: QTNLSC worst set, automatic slicing, S/D exclude_near) with the device oxide y-mesh spacing halved at the oxide lines (Al2O3 line 0.25 -> 0.125 nm, HfO2 line 1.0 -> 0.5 nm); the y = 0 IWO/Al2O3 line (0.0625 nm, shared with the IWO interface mesh) is unchanged. Actual refinement (run_0067 equilibrium.str + geometric grading): Al2O3 15 -> about 22 intervals (largest 0.25 -> 0.125 nm, smallest 0.06 nm unchanged), HfO2 28 -> about 55, i.e. Al2O3 about x1.5 and HfO2 about x2. Timeout x4.5: run_0067 took 1246 s on 9594 nodes and 43 oxide intervals per slice; this deck has about 13.7k nodes and about 77 (run_0062, 13,689 nodes and 75, ran out of memory at the old 2 GB limit).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: resolved log10 |I_G| changes by <= 0.1 dec at every V_G vs S0-02 (run_0067); points below the demonstrated resolution are censored, never a pass (register section 0 and H-C; score_register.py hc_mesh)
